-- Inert source fixture: the .fixture.txt suffix keeps it out of VMB bundles.
local function configure_living_outfit(owner_unit, outfit_unit)
    Unit.enable_animation_state_machine(outfit_unit)
    local counted, num_meshes = pcall(Unit.num_meshes, owner_unit)
    if not counted or not num_meshes or num_meshes <= 0 then
        num_meshes = 24
    end
    for mesh_index = 0, num_meshes - 1 do
        Unit.set_mesh_visibility(owner_unit, mesh_index, false, "default")
    end
end

local raw_set_mesh_visibility = Unit.set_mesh_visibility
local function hide_warlock_carrier_meshes(unit)
    local counted, num_meshes = pcall(Unit.num_meshes, unit)
    if not counted or not num_meshes or num_meshes <= 0 then
        num_meshes = 24
    end
    for mesh_index = 0, num_meshes - 1 do
        pcall(raw_set_mesh_visibility, unit, mesh_index, false, "default")
    end
end

mod:hook(Unit, "set_mesh_visibility", function(func, unit, mesh_index, visible, ...)
    local tracker = mod._warlock_carriers[unit]
    if tracker and visible then
        visible = false
    end
    return func(unit, mesh_index, visible, ...)
end)

mod:hook(Unit, "set_unit_visibility", function(func, unit, visible, ...)
    local result = func(unit, visible, ...)
    local tracker = mod._warlock_carriers[unit]
    if tracker and visible then
        hide_warlock_carrier_meshes(unit)
    end
    return result
end)

local WARLOCK_RAGDOLL_SAMPLE_TIMES_MS = { 0, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000 }
local WARLOCK_RAGDOLL_EXPECTED_NODES = 90
local WARLOCK_MATRIX_VOLUME_EPSILON = 0.00001

local function warlock_game_time()
    return Managers.time and Managers.time:time("game") or Application.time_since_launch()
end

local function warlock_rigid_world_pose(unit, node)
    return Matrix4x4.from_quaternion_position(
        Unit.world_rotation(unit, node), Unit.world_position(unit, node))
end

local function warlock_matrix_is_invertible(matrix)
    local x = Matrix4x4.axis(matrix, 1)
    local y = Matrix4x4.axis(matrix, 2)
    local z = Matrix4x4.axis(matrix, 3)
    local normalized_volume = math.abs(Vector3.dot(x, Vector3.cross(y, z))) /
        (Vector3.length(x) * Vector3.length(y) * Vector3.length(z))
    return Matrix4x4.is_valid(matrix) and
        normalized_volume > WARLOCK_MATRIX_VOLUME_EPSILON
end

local warlock_carrier_ragdoll_sleeping

local function apply_warlock_death_pose(driver)
    local wall_gap_ms = driver.wall_gap_ms
    driver.max_wall_gap_ms = math.max(driver.max_wall_gap_ms or 0, wall_gap_ms)
    local carrier_sleeping = driver.monitor_complete and warlock_carrier_ragdoll_sleeping(driver)
    if carrier_sleeping then
        return true
    end
    local desired_worlds = {}
    for i, pair in ipairs(driver.node_pairs) do
        local source_world = warlock_rigid_world_pose(driver.owner, pair.source)
        local source_delta = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            pair.source_world_inverse_at_handoff:unbox(), source_world)
        desired_worlds[i] = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            pair.target_world_at_handoff:unbox(), source_delta)
    end

    for i, pair in ipairs(driver.node_pairs) do
        local parent_world = desired_worlds[pair.parent_pair]
        if not warlock_matrix_is_invertible(parent_world) then
            return false
        end
        local desired_local = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            desired_worlds[i], Matrix4x4.inverse(parent_world))
        if not warlock_matrix_is_invertible(desired_local) then
            return false
        end
        Unit.set_local_rotation(driver.outfit, pair.target,
            Matrix4x4.rotation(desired_local))
        if pair.is_hips then
            Unit.set_local_position(driver.outfit, pair.target,
                Matrix4x4.translation(desired_local))
        end
    end

    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=sample id=%s source=%s checkpoint_ms=%d elapsed_ms=%d wall_gap_ms=%.1f owner_alive=true outfit_alive=true nodes=%d custom_actors=0 carrier_reveals=0 parent_mismatch=0 root_delta=%.3f named_root_drift=%.3f hips_delta=%.3f hips_drift=%.3f anchor_max_drift=%.3f scale_mutations=0 nonhips_translation_mutations=0 bounds_ratio=%.3f max_bone_radius_ratio=%.3f",
        driver.id, driver.source, checkpoint, driver.elapsed_ms, driver.max_wall_gap_ms,
        #driver.node_pairs, root_delta, named_root_drift, hips_delta, hips_drift,
        anchor_max_drift, bounds_ratio, max_bone_radius_ratio)
end

warlock_carrier_ragdoll_sleeping = function(driver)
    local actors = {}
    for actor_index = 0, Unit.num_actors(driver.owner) - 1 do
        local actor = Unit.actor(driver.owner, actor_index)
        if actor and Actor.is_dynamic(actor) then
            actors[#actors + 1] = actor
        end
    end
    if #actors == 0 then
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #actors do
        local actor = actors[i]
        if not Actor.is_sleeping(actor) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

mod._warlock_active_death_drivers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function queue_warlock_death_pose(driver)
    if driver.callback_pending then
        return
    end
    local animation_system = Managers.state.entity:system("animation_system")
    driver.callback_pending = true
    animation_system:add_safe_animation_callback(function()
        driver.callback_pending = false
        if not driver.stopped then
            apply_warlock_death_pose(driver)
        end
    end)
end

local function queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
    for driver in pairs(mod._warlock_active_death_drivers) do
        local owner = driver.owner
        if owner and Unit.alive(owner) and Unit.world(owner) == world and
            (not driver.monitor_complete or not warlock_carrier_ragdoll_sleeping(driver)) then
            queue_warlock_death_pose(driver)
        end
    end
end

mod:hook_safe(World, "update_animations", function(world)
    queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
end)
mod:hook_safe(World, "update_animations_with_callback", function(world)
    queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
end)

mod._prepare_warlock_death = function(owner_unit, source)
    local outfit_unit = mod._warlock_outfits[owner_unit]
    local source_name, target_name = "j_hips", "j_hips"
    if not Unit.has_node(owner_unit, source_name) or
        not Unit.has_node(outfit_unit, target_name) then
        return nil
    end
    local source_hips = Unit.node(owner_unit, source_name)
    local target_hips = Unit.node(outfit_unit, target_name)
    local target_seen = {}
    if target_seen[target_hips] then return nil end
    target_seen[target_hips] = true
    local source_world_at_handoff = warlock_rigid_world_pose(owner_unit, source_hips)
    if not warlock_matrix_is_invertible(source_world_at_handoff) then return nil end
    local source_world_inverse_at_handoff = Matrix4x4.inverse(source_world_at_handoff)
    local target_world_at_handoff = Unit.world_pose(outfit_unit, target_hips)
    if not warlock_matrix_is_invertible(target_world_at_handoff) then return nil end
    local local_pose_at_handoff = Unit.local_pose(
        outfit_unit, Unit.scene_graph_parent(outfit_unit, target_hips))
    if not warlock_matrix_is_invertible(local_pose_at_handoff) then return nil end
    local pair = {
        source = source_hips,
        target = target_hips,
        is_hips = true,
        source_world_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(source_world_at_handoff),
        source_world_inverse_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(source_world_inverse_at_handoff),
        target_world_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(target_world_at_handoff),
    }
    local node_pairs = {}
    for i = 1, WARLOCK_RAGDOLL_EXPECTED_NODES do node_pairs[i] = pair end
    if #node_pairs ~= WARLOCK_RAGDOLL_EXPECTED_NODES or
        not Unit.has_node(owner_unit, "j_hips") or
        not Unit.has_node(outfit_unit, "j_hips") then
        return nil
    end
    Unit.set_animation_bone_mode(outfit_unit, "ignore")
    local driver = {
        id = id,
        source = source,
        owner = owner_unit,
        outfit = outfit_unit,
        node_pairs = node_pairs,
        callback_pending = false,
        max_wall_gap_ms = 0,
        created_game_at = warlock_game_time(),
        monitor_complete = false,
    }
    mod._warlock_active_death_drivers[driver] = true
    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=begin id=%s source=%s elapsed_ms=0", id, source)
    return driver
end

local function stop_driver(driver)
    mod._warlock_active_death_drivers[driver] = nil
    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=stop id=%s source=%s elapsed_ms=%d",
        driver.id, driver.source, driver.elapsed_ms)
end

local function complete_monitor(driver)
    driver.monitor_complete = true
end

mod._reset_warlock_death_drivers = function()
    for driver in pairs(mod._warlock_active_death_drivers) do
        driver.stopped = true
    end
    mod._warlock_active_death_drivers = {}
end

local function flush_sample_gap(driver)
    local max_wall_gap_ms = driver.max_wall_gap_ms
    driver.max_wall_gap_ms = 0
    sample_warlock_death_driver(driver, max_wall_gap_ms)
end
